description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing the wishlist feature in a React/Redux e-commerce application. It includes functions to update the wishlist (like/unlike products) and fetch the current wishlist from an API, utilizing axios for HTTP requests and dispatching actions to update the application state and show notifications.

methods.name: updateWishlist
methods.description: Asynchronous action creator to add or remove a product from the wishlist, showing notifications based on success or login status.

methods.name: fetchWishlist
methods.description: Asynchronous action creator to fetch the current wishlist from the API and update the Redux store.
